verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents programmatic access to sensitive verification results and manual review tools. It shows no documented retention windows and no redaction or deletion API that scrubs collected PII on demand. Being able to access data later is adjacent to controlling its lifecycle, not the capability itself, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can control what happens to collected identity data — documented retention windows and a redaction or deletion API that scrubs PII on demand
